phase: pre-training draft review; runner still being edited

accepted_method.opponent_primary: visual keeper v2 + balanced + original B-Human motions
accepted_method.observation: published rl_obs_v1, 19 fields, privileged striker scene plus PerceptionNoise v1
accepted_method.new_reward: striker_visual_reward_v2: each step -0.02, terminal actual goal +10, every other terminal -10

accepted_method.test: 100 new paired episodes per striker per keeper, selected once from validation, no test tuning
accepted_method.main_metric: actual goals / all scheduled penalties; misses, falls, timeouts, simulation failures stay denominator
accepted_method.uncertainty: paired goal-indicator bootstrap plus per-policy binomial intervals
accepted_method.scope: bounded simulation pilot; no convergence or hardware equivalence
